item.title: The KEY Election Day Storylines That Matter, with Victor Davis Hanson and Mark Halperin, Plus NEW Details About the Plane Crash | Ep. 1433 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
It's Election Day! Megyn Kelly is joined by Victor Davis Hanson, author of “The Counterrevolution,” to discuss President Trump’s closing message ahead of Election Day, how it could affect voting, a historical perspective on midterm elections, the political battle ahead after the midterms, how Democrats could overplay their hand, and more. Then Mark Halperin, host of Next Up, joins to discuss how the ongoing war in Iran could affect the midterms, Ron DeSantis speaking out about how Iran negatively affects GOP voters, Trump announcing he's ending all aid to Israel at the end of the year, whether Haley Stevens' endorsement of the GOP candidate in Michigan will matter, Amy Acton's bizarre way of talking, why some of Trump’s most loyal MAGA supporters are turning away from him in 2026, the key issues that matter this year, and more. Then Megyn closes with what we're learning about all the victims of the tragic Florida private plane crash, the young children on board, the safety concerns surrounding private air travel, why people are wrong to critique the young co-pilot of the Florida private plane crash, why her communication with air traffic control may have helped save lives, and more.
